_what: Where 07_estop_tower_cradle.stl sits on the Vega. See PLACEMENT.md. All points in the URDF `base` link frame, millimetres.
frame_origin: chassis centre (base mesh spans x -345..345, y -275..275, z -3.5..347); floor at z ~ -54
T_base_from_stl_note: STL vertices are already base-frame mm; this matrix converts them to base-frame metres (URDF units). No rotation, no offset.

ledge.note: The left E-stop's seating ledge. The skirt (OD 54 / ID 40, 20.5 tall) sits on this plane around the button.

anchors_note: Two M4 E-stop screw holes, axis = ledge normal. The CAD scripts and README call x=125.5 'forward'; that label is wrong, +x is the robot's front.

cradle.note: Cradle local frame from 02_iphone_cradle.py: X across the phone, Y from back panel toward the screen, Z up from the base-plate underside. Phone back (camera) faces +x, screen faces -x (toward the torso).

phone_camera.note: Nominal is a +-20 mm estimate from CAD. Measure the phone-to-base extrinsic on each installation with scripts/base_tracking/calibration; do not use the CAD pose as a calibration.
